Overview.Name: Rajeshwari Yellati
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Reducing arthritis-related discomfort and inflammation, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, Improving mobility, energy and body composition
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results, avoids non-veg on Thursday, Friday and Saturday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Follow vegetarian options on Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
Reduce sweets, bakery foods and packaged snacks to help reduce inflammation.
Regular yoga and gentle walking can improve joint mobility and stiffness.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Maintain consistent meal timing and hydration throughout the day.
Include a variety of vegetables regularly to support joint health and recovery.
Try a short walk after meals to support digestion and overall health.
